title: Approved Units on FBN Warehouse-Loss Cases: Calculation Note
content:
The units approved on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss case are the units claimed on the case, less the shrinkage allowance after it is limited to the allowance cap, less the verification holdback, less the compliance holdback, each deducted from the units claimed in that order; a negative remainder counts as zero, and the remainder is then capped at the approval limit plus the limit uplift.

## Values used

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Desk review span | 6 months |
| Case-history span | 12 months |
| Shrinkage allowance | 0.4% (0.004) of the units of the case's SKU on inbound receipts dated inside the desk review span, rounded down to a whole unit |
| Allowance cap | 8 units |
| Verification holdback | 1 unit |
| Compliance holdback | 1 unit |
| Approval limit | 10 units |
| Limit uplift | none (0 units) |

For a warehouse-loss approval, a record is dated inside the desk review span or the case-history span when fewer than that span's number of whole months have passed from its date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

The case is the seller's open warehouse-loss case, and the units claimed are those recorded on it.

## Structure of the figure

1. Allowance applied: the shrinkage allowance or the allowance cap, whichever is lower.
2. Net: the units claimed, less the allowance applied, less the verification holdback, less the compliance holdback; below zero it is zero.
3. Units approved: the net or the approval limit plus the limit uplift, whichever is lower.

## Worked examples (hypothetical cases)

| | Case A | Case B | Case C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Units claimed | 25 | 14 | 6 |
| Units received on the SKU inside the desk review span | 1800 | 3000 | 1800 |
| Shrinkage allowance (0.4%, rounded down) | 7 | 12 | 7 |
| Allowance applied (lower of allowance and 8) | 7 | 8 | 7 |
| Net after holdbacks of 1 and 1 | 16 | 4 | 0 (6 less 7 less 1 less 1 is below zero) |
| Ceiling: approval limit 10 plus uplift 0 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| **Units approved** | **10** | **4** | **0** |

In Case A the net of 25 less 7 less 1 less 1, which is 16, is held to 10.
